sources.authority: Mississippi Office of State Aid Road Construction (county roads and bridges, all 82 counties)
sources.agency: Mississippi Office of State Aid Road Construction (county roads and bridges, all 82 counties)
sources.planned_filter: type_work IN ('BRIDGE & APPROACHES','BOX BRIDGE & APPROACHES','BOX CULVERT & APPROACHES','GRADE DRAIN BASE & SURFACING','WIDENING & OVERLAY','BASE & SURFACING','BASE PREPARATION & SURFACING')
sources.notes: ONLY STATEWIDE Mississippi source found. Layer id is 1 (layer 0 does not exist). Edited 2026-11-16, records modified through 2026-11-13. Every row has Const_Status 'ACTIVE' (finished work is moved to the separate Completed_Projects service), so the filter is by work type: it keeps 151 of 535 rows (bridge replacements, box culverts, grade-drain-base and widening) and drops reseal, overlay, striping and maintenance (384) which take no land. CAVEAT: these are projects already awarded to a contractor (award_date filled, Work_begin empty on 534), so right-of-way is normally acquired already; treat as late-stage signal. Site splits one project into several rows; dates are text YYYY-MM-DD. fund_SA gives the programme (SAP, LSBP, SABP). Plans_link points to a SharePoint PDF. Web maps: osarc.maps.arcgis.com webmap e76a418ad3404d23a6faad9da3dc2cc2. No licence text on the item.

summary: Checked 2026-11-17. 18 verified ArcGIS sources for Mississippi. Statewide: OSARC State Aid active county road and bridge projects (535; 151 after the work-type filter) - awarded projects, so late-stage. Gulf Coast: Gulfport capital improvement projects with a Phase field including 'Property Acquisition' and 'Design/ROW', and the Gulf Regional Planning Commission's FY2027-2030 TIP layers (roadway, intersections, bike/ped) plus the 2025 set with federal cost. Jackson area: CMPDD TIP 2027-2030 and 2025-2028 congestion-mitigation and MDOT layers, the MTP 2045 visionary list, and Brandon / Rankin County / reservoir district plan roads (geometry and type only). DeSoto County: Olive Branch road plan (60 widenings and extensions, stale 2022) and annexation easement polygons. Hattiesburg: city projects (stale 2022). Pipelines: Mississippi Crossing and SSE4 proposed routes (third-party digitization of FERC filings). STILL MISSING: any MDOT state-highway source (STIP / Five-Year Plan are PDF or ASPX only; GeoServer 403); Memphis MPO and Hattiesburg MPO programmes (PDF only); DeSoto County server unreachable; no Legistar site in the state.
